assignment_context:
Assignment Title: Exception Handling in Java – Employee Payroll

Assignment Question:
Design an Employee Payroll System in Java that accepts employee  details and calculates the employee's net salary. The system should demonstrate exception handling for invalid input. Create a class named Employee with the data members employeeId, employeeName, basicSalary, and workingDays. The class should contain methods calculateNetSalary() to calculate the net salary and displayDetails() to display the employee information. The program should handle respective exception handlers when numeric input contains invalid characters and when the working days value results in an invalid division.
 
Input Validation Conditions
The following conditions must be satisfied:
·       employeeId must be a positive integer.
·       employeeName must not be empty.
·       basicSalary must be greater than 0.
·       workingDays must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 31.
·       The input must contain exactly four values.
·       Numeric values must contain valid integer/decimal values.
·       Net salary is calculated as:
 
Daily Salary = Basic Salary / Working Days
Net Salary = Daily Salary × Working Days
Input Format
The input consists of four lines:
<employeeId>
<employeeName>
<basicSalary>
<workingDays>
Output Format
For valid input:
<employeeId>
<employeeName>
<netSalary>
For invalid input, the program prints:
Invalid Input
Sample Input
101
Arun
30000
25
Sample Output
101
Arun
30000.00
